title: Sign in
description: Sign in with Google or Facebook to keep your currency, preferences and calculations on any device.

panel.intro: You don't need an account to use the calculator: with one, your settings and calculations follow you to any device.
panel.facebook-soon: Signing in with Facebook will be available soon.
panel.waking-up: The server is waking up (it can take up to a minute the first time)…
panel.error: We couldn't sign you in. Please try again in a few minutes.
panel.provider-error: The sign-in button couldn't load. Check your connection or whether a blocker is stopping it.
panel.unavailable: Sign-in isn't available yet. Meanwhile, everything you enter is saved on this device.
panel.legal: By continuing you accept the {terms} and the {privacy}.
